reason: Provides user-facing Windows controls in general settings to close and restart DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web hosts, with explicit confirmation and documented interruption of running tasks.

summaries.zh: 在通用设置中为 Windows 上的 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 与 Web 提供关闭和重启主机的控制按钮。
summaries.en: Adds Windows controls in General Settings to close and restart the DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web host.

capabilities: Provides Windows controls to close the DeepSeek Harness Desktop or Web host
Terminates the Desktop or Web host process and its descendants
Restarts the Desktop executable or Web host with the original invocation
Creates a PowerShell helper process for Desktop lifecycle operations
